title: ServerManagement
tagline: One encrypted workstation for your servers, network, hypervisors and clouds.
dataNote: Your hosts, passwords, keys and settings stay on this PC, encrypted with AES-256-GCM.
intro: This sets up ServerManagement on this PC: SSH, Remote Desktop and VNC sessions, files, hypervisors, five clouds, Microsoft 365 and Bitwarden in one encrypted workstation. Built by an IT engineer, for engineers. Free and open source.

highlights.title: Post-quantum by design
highlights.detail: ML-KEM and ML-DSA hybrids for SSH, team libraries and updates; everything saved is AES-256-GCM.

highlights.title: Everything in one place
highlights.detail: Terminals, Remote Desktop, files, Docker, Proxmox, Hyper-V, vCenter and the clouds, side by side.

highlights.title: Your secrets stay yours
highlights.detail: Encrypted on this PC with Windows Hello; Bitwarden and Password Safe sign-ins are read into memory, never saved.

highlights.title: Built for organisations
highlights.detail: Group Policy for every setting, admin-approved security switches and a full audit log.

builtBy: Built by DarkCipher0x at DarkCipher Systems
doneNote: Your first start walks you through setting it up. Help, guides and the bug and feature request forms are at darkciphersystems.com.

options.title: Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime
options.detail: Required for terminals and the portal browser.

options.title: Nmap
options.detail: Network discovery and port checks. Downloaded from nmap.org and checked; opens its own setup (with Npcap) to finish.

options.title: Ollama
options.detail: Optional GPU AI engine. Skip it if Ollama runs on another machine.

removeData.title: Also remove my data and settings
removeData.detail: Hosts, credentials, notes and settings for this Windows user. Leave off to keep them for a reinstall.
